issues.description: Loop-cost reasoning uplift contradicts its own stated assumption: at docs/04 catalogue rates (Sonnet 5.5 $2/$10 per M) 460k in / 96k out costs $1.88, and doubling output for reasoning adds $0.96, giving about $2.84 (x2 = about $5.7 per run), not ~$2.4 (x2 = ~$5); the mixed row's ~$0.45 is the no-reasoning figure (0.42), with reasoning about $0.62 (x2 = about $1.25), so 'about 18 runs on the mixed option' is about 14-15; docs/05 R10 repeats the $5 figure. Conclusion (R10 trigger not fired, $20 kept) is unaffected.

Deviation 'Ledger records lost' says the script has since gained --append, but scripts/smoke_run.py lines 55-58 still unlink the smoke ledger and verdicts by default when --append is not passed, so the append-only violation (FND-F-01) remains the default behaviour; the review presents this as remedied.

Jev-to-Sonnet replay (0.976 at 2.8%) comes from vera/bench/metrics.py pairing cheap repeat r with reference repeat r mod 3, not the same repeat; replay restricted to matched repeats 0-2 gives 0.974 at 2.9%; the pairing is not disclosed.
OpenRouter credit limit is recorded as set but its amount is not, so the SPEC rule that the key has a matching credit limit cannot be verified from the repository.
About $0.077 of Increment 1 spend (three earlier smoke runs) rests on console output only; no repository record supports it (disclosed in the review).
Dogfood overhead hours were not logged for the second increment running; recorded as an accepted deviation with a 10-16 h total estimate and no Meridian share (dogfood.sh report shows 0).

notes: GAPS: 1. Sonnet reasoning uplift arithmetic wrong (~$2.4 stated, ~$2.84 by the stated assumption; per-run ~$5 should be ~$5.7); mixed row omits reasoning uplift (~$1.25 per run, not ~$1); run counts for October overstated (~14-15 mixed, not 18); same $5 figure in docs/05 R10. 2. smoke_run.py still deletes its ledger by default without --append; the stated remedy does not remove the defect. 3. Jev-to-Sonnet sweep pairs repeat r with reference repeat r mod 3 (undisclosed); matched-repeat replay 0.974 at 2.9% vs 0.976 at 2.8%. 4. Credit-limit amount not recorded. 5. $0.077 smoke spend unverifiable (disclosed). 6. Overhead hours not logged (accepted deviation).
